problems.problem: The generated hall wall carries scattered faint digit glyphs ('8', '20', '28', '82', '84', '40' near y=190 and y=695) baked into the paint. In the contact-detail crop (456,1069,970,1319) a stray light speck also sits on the parquet right of the gold heel. These read as rendering artifacts on an otherwise clean matte wall and cheapen an otherwise luxe field; references 3-4 show immaculate gradient grounds.

Inspecting the contact crop before judging: a soft dark contact shadow does exist under the red toe (shadow offset_y 0 is correct, do not move it down). However the polished gold stiletto tip ends ~25px above the parquet with no darkening or reflection beneath it, so the heel reads as hovering; the brief's own concept demands contact at 'toe and heel tips'. Additionally the baked pool of light on the floor sits left of the shoe (crop x≈0-260) while the shoe's own key comes from upper-front-left, so the floor glow does not motivate the product's highlights.

The narrow-sans monument wraps to three lines ('Very / Good / Girl') although the concept declares two tall wrapped lines; at max_width 360 the third line 'Girl' plus the gold rule push the column foot to y≈929, leaving a dead gap of ~350px between the rule and the floor horizon and unbalancing the left column against the 806px-tall shoe. Hierarchy logo→title is correct and text_product_overlap is false, so this is a wrapping/rhythm fault, not an overlap.

Empty subtitle and price slots were still reserved in the layout logic: the left column terminates at the rule (y≈929) while the right column's shoe base sits at y=1209, so the two columns never visually rhyme; the lower-left quadrant is a large vacant parquet area with no anchor, unlike references 2-3 where the ground plane carries reflection or glow that ties product to frame.

changes.value: Deep ink-blue matte painted hall wall, perfectly clean and unmarked, meeting a continuous dark lacquered parquet ground at a low horizontal horizon; one soft warm pool of ambient light glowing on the parquet centered beneath the right-hand subject zone, faint elongated sheen stretching toward the viewer on the lacquered boards, gentle diffuse nocturnal illumination, no objects, no text, no marks
